query: storm damage to gutter and fascia, pre-existing rot noted by contractor

results.title: Fascia and gutter failure where rot was previously identified
results.summary: Contractor's own note recorded existing rot at the fixings. Denied under the disrepair exclusion: the storm was the occasion of the failure, not its cause. Upheld on review.

results.title: Storm claim declined where disrepair was flagged at a prior inspection
results.summary: Denied. Prior inspection record was decisive.
